title: Balanced transfer of deferred signed networks: conditional κ = 6.3978919675787e-5
body:
Verification complete: full repository coverage (78 isolated test modules, 20 patch checks), corrected-head complete physical/native replay, exact arithmetic and six controls passed. All 42 research-head GitHub checks passed. The initial full invocation passed `make verify` then failed only on an ignored bytecode-cache pin; the cache-only repair and successful package rerun are disclosed in `research/deferred-balanced/validation.json`. No mathematical source changed.

Under the inherited analytic and fixed-tape hypotheses, this composes Zhihao Chen's PR97 physical interfaces with the repository's existing balanced positional layout and sharper exact moment enclosures:

**κ = 63978919675787/10^18 = 6.3978919675787×10⁻⁵**, **0.0204901% above PR97's stated κ**.

This is an explicit two-part result:

| Assembly | κ |
|---|---:|
| PR97 as published | 6.3965813e-5 |
| Same PR97 original-prefix assembly, refined arithmetic | 6.3974826635492e-5 |
| Additional inherited balanced positional layout | **6.3978919675787e-5** |

The stronger value uses an additional physical-layout argument, not just a relaxed inequality. Common low-coordinate FFT groups and the paid coordinate router give the balanced prefix-work margin 1−ε; the old 1−ε(1+c) remains a positive geometric constraint. A negative control rejects charging the old prefix cost at these parameters.

No local gate, frame, endpoint, signed correction or child histogram changes. Both tensor connectors, copied centers, nonzero entrance/exit gauges and the inverse rank-one correction remain charged. The complete (m,W,s) triples remain (529,108516254,57403754177) and (576,207387136,119453132304). The refined bit saving is 15995753310011/250000000000000000; the complex saving used by the assembly remains PR97's 36926111/500000000000.

Validation includes the original full forward/reflected and signed physical ledgers, complete dirty replay, tensor/signed endpoint controls and 4,096,576-coefficient complex identity. Two independent exact moment enclosures, next-grid rejections, all 47 strict constraints, seven margins, eventual cutoffs and six new adversarial controls pass.

A clean PR97 checkout omitted four logs required by its manifest. This branch regenerates them with the unchanged source checkers, preserves the original manifest and expected hashes, and updates only the corresponding log hashes. Fresh successful receipts and the original missing-file failure are retained. The initial local integration also required installing SymPy 1.14.0; that setup failure is recorded separately. No failed invocation is represented as passing.

Reproduce:
```sh
python -m pip install sympy==1.14.0
python research/deferred-balanced/verify.py --replay-own
python research/deferred-balanced/test_controls.py
python research/deferred-balanced/verify.py --replay
make verify
```

See `research/deferred-balanced/PROOF.md` for the transfer and review boundaries. Finite checks do not prove the inherited all-size interfaces. No new Lean theorem, unconditional result, practical speedup or global optimality is claimed.

Credit **Zhihao Chen / jacklightChen** for PR97's reflected schedules, fan ordering, gauge accounting, signed phase correction and interface integration; **Swapnil Jain** for the frozen round7/round6 networks; James Chang/PR34 and RaD/hipotures for the inherited balanced transfer; PR65 and all original arithmetic contributors. Also retain Avi Eisenberg/ikeboy, icekylinx, Paureel, Chafik Boukhalfa, Dominik Scholz, OpenAI and all earlier authors' attribution and AI disclosures. This refinement/composition was prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance.
